newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian maverick Afrobeat star Fela dies.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian maverick Afrobeat star Fela dies.

text.p: Nigeria's maverick Afrobeat singer Fela Anikulapo-Kuti, who helped to popularise the continent's music across the globe, died on Saturday, national television said.

The television quoted Anikulapo-Kuti's elder brother Olikoye Ransome-Kuti as saying the singer, who won a reputation for smoking cannabis and wearing only his underpants, died at around 4.p.m. (1500 GMT).
Anikulapo-Kuti had been sick for several weeks with an undisclosed illness for which he himself had only recently permitted treatment.
Known to his fans as "Fela", he rose to both national and international fame with his distinctive Afrobeat music and Bohemian lifestyle.
He was a thorn in the side of many of the military regimes that have dominated Nigeria and was on numerous occasions detained on various charges.

However, in recent years he toned down his anti-military stance, staying mostly at his home in the working class Lagos district of Ikeja and playing only infrequently at his club, known as "The Shrine".
